result.topic_en: Latin notes giving a list of integrals from 0 to e^{xi} of logarithms of elliptic moduli and of expressions in K, k, k' with respect to dq/q, each evaluated as series of logarithms of tangents, sines and cosines plus correction terms involving bracketed (integer-part) functions.
result.transcription:
4.
- convergat $q$ modo supra stabilito
versus limitem $q_c$, convergere ver-
sus limitem finitum, ejusque
valorem assignat.
Perinde obtinetur
63) $\int_0^{e^{xi}} -\log k' \frac{dq}{q} = -2\log tg \frac{x}{2}^2 - \frac{2}{9} tg(\frac{3x}{2})^2 - \frac{2}{25}\log tg(\frac{5x}{2})^2 - \dots$
$+ 4\pi i\left((\frac{x}{2\pi}) - (\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac12)\right) + \frac{4\pi i}{9}\left((\frac{3x}{2\pi}) - (\frac{3x}{2\pi}+\frac12)\right) + \frac{4\pi i}{25}\left((\frac{5x}{2\pi}) - (\frac{5x}{2\pi}+\frac12)\right) + \dots$
$= -\sum_{-\infty,\infty} \frac{\log tg(\frac{px}{2})^2}{p^2} + \left[4\pi i \sum_{1,\infty}^{p} \frac{1}{p^2}\left((\frac{px}{2\pi}) - (\frac{px}{2\pi}+\frac12)\right)\right]$
64) $\int_0^{e^{xi}} \log\frac{2K}{\pi}\frac{dq}{q} = 2\log 4\cos(\frac{x}{2})^2 + \frac{2}{9}\log 4\cos\frac{3x}{2}^2 \dots$ {+$= \sum_{-\infty,\infty}\frac{\log 4\cos\frac{px}{2}^2}{p^2}\left[+4\pi i\sum_{1,\infty}\frac{1}{p^2}(\frac{px}{2\pi})\right.$+}
$+ 4\pi i(\frac{x}{2\pi}) + \frac{4\pi i}{9}(\frac{3x}{2\pi}) + \frac{4\pi i}{25}(\frac{5x}{2\pi}) + \dots =$
65) $\int_0^{e^{xi}} (\frac{2K}{\pi}-1)\frac{dq}{q} = -2\log 4\sin\frac{x}{2}^2 + \frac{2}{3}\log 4\sin\frac{3x}{2}^2 - \frac{2}{5}\log 4\sin(\frac{5x}{2})^2 + \dots$
$-4\pi i(\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac12) + \frac{4\pi i}{3}(\frac{3x}{2\pi}+\frac12) \dots$
[pencil: 433/78]
$= i\log tg(\frac{2x+\pi}{4})^2 + \frac{i}{2}\log tg(\frac{4x+\pi}{4})^2 + \frac{i}{3}\log tg(\frac{6x+\pi}{4})^2 + \dots$
$+2\pi\left((\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac14) - (\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac34)\right) + \frac{2\pi}{2}\left((\frac{2x}{2\pi}+\frac14) - (\frac{2x}{2\pi}+\frac34)\right) + \frac{2\pi}{3}\left((\frac{3x}{2\pi}+\frac14) - (\frac{3x}{2\pi}+\frac34)\right) + \dots$
66) $\int_0^{e^{xi}} \frac{2kK}{\pi}\frac{dq}{q} = -2\log tg\frac{x}{4}^2 + \frac{2}{3}\log tg\frac{3x}{4}^2 - \frac{2}{5}\log tg\frac{5x}{4}^2 + \dots$
$+4\pi i\left((\frac{x}{4\pi}) - (\frac{x}{4\pi}+\frac12)\right) - \frac{4\pi i}{3}\left((\frac{3x}{4\pi}) - (\frac{3x}{4\pi}+\frac12)\right) + \dots$
$= 2i\log tg(\frac{x+\pi}{4})^2 + \frac{2i}{3}\log tg\frac{3x+\pi}{4}^2 + \frac{2i}{5}\log tg(\frac{5x+\pi}{4})^2 + \dots$
$+4\pi\left((\frac{x}{4\pi}+\frac14) - (\frac{x}{4\pi}+\frac34)\right) + \frac{4\pi}{3}\left((\frac{3x}{4\pi}+\frac14) - (\frac{3x}{4\pi}+\frac34)\right) + \dots$
67) $\int_0^{e^{xi}} (\frac{2k'K}{\pi}-1)\frac{dq}{q} = -2\log 4\cos\frac{x}{2}^2 + \frac{2}{3}\log 4\cos\frac{3x}{2}^2 - \frac{2}{5}\log 4\cos\frac{5x}{2}^2 + \dots$
$-4\pi i(\frac{x}{2\pi}) + \frac{4\pi i}{3}(\frac{3x}{2\pi}) - \frac{4\pi i}{5}(\frac{5x}{2\pi}) + \dots$
$= -i\log tg(\frac{2x+\pi}{4})^2 + \frac{i}{2}\log tg(\frac{4x+\pi}{4})^2 - \frac{i}{3}\log tg\frac{6x+\pi}{4}^2 + \dots$
$-2\pi\left((\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac14) - (\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac34)\right) + \frac{2\pi}{2}\left((\frac{2x}{2\pi}+\frac14) - (\frac{2x}{2\pi}+\frac34)\right) - \dots$
68) $\int_0^{e^{xi}} (\frac{2\sqrt{k'}K}{\pi}-1)\frac{dq}{q} = -\log 4\cos x^2 + \frac13\log 4\cos 3x^2 - \frac15\log 4\cos 5x^2 + \dots$
$-2\pi i(\frac{x}{\pi}) + \frac{2\pi i}{3}(\frac{3x}{\pi}) - \frac{2\pi i}{5}(\frac{5x}{\pi}) + \dots$
$= -\frac{i}{2}\log tg(x+\frac{\pi}{4})^2 + \frac{i}{4}\log tg(2x+\frac{\pi}{4})^2 - \frac16\log tg(3x+\frac{\pi}{4})^2 + \dots$
$-\pi\left((\frac{x}{\pi}+\frac14) - (\frac{x}{\pi}+\frac34)\right) + \frac{\pi}{2}\left((\frac{2x}{\pi}+\frac14) - (\frac{2x}{\pi}+\frac34)\right) - \frac{\pi}{3}\left((\frac{3x}{\pi}+\frac14) - (\frac{3x}{\pi}+\frac34)\right) + \dots$

methods.what: Boundary value of the integral of -log k' dq/q as q tends radially to e^{xi}, expressed as a series of log tan terms plus bracket-function corrections
Boundary value of the integral of log(2K/pi) dq/q as a series of log 4cos^2 terms with bracket corrections
Boundary value of the integral of (2K/pi - 1) dq/q, given in two series forms (log sin and log tan)
Boundary value of the integral of 2kK/pi dq/q, given in two series forms
Boundary value of the integral of (2k'K/pi - 1) dq/q, given in two series forms
Boundary value of the integral of (2 sqrt(k') K/pi - 1) dq/q, given in two series forms
